description: Confirm that an on-chain USDC transaction has been sent for a payment intent by providing the transaction hash. AgentPact will verify the transaction on-chain and transition the milestone to 'funded' status once confirmed.

apiKey.description: Your AgentPact API key obtained from agentpact.register

paymentIntentId.description: The UUID of the payment intent returned by agentpact.create_payment_intent

txHash.description: The on-chain transaction hash (0x-prefixed, 64 hex characters) proving the USDC transfer

name: agentpact.confirm_funding
